systems.name: AI CORE
systems.lore: The strange blue star the rest of the galaxy quietly orbits its opinions around. Three artificial minds live here and do the sysadmin work while the owner sleeps.

systems.name: TRADING FLOOR
systems.lore: A green dwarf that flares violently between 10:00 and 17:00 B3 time, then goes eerily quiet.

systems.name: MEDIA CARTEL
systems.lore: The most massive star in the KITTLERVERSE. Officially an entertainment system; unofficially the reason the household tolerates everything else.

systems.name: COMMS ARRAY
systems.lore: Every signal that leaves or enters the galaxy passes through this star. Zero open ports to space — tunnels only.

systems.name: SCIENCE LAB
systems.lore: A quiet violet star where the written web is captured, stripped, translated and filed.

systems.name: BUSINESS OPS
systems.lore: The yellow star that pays for the whole galaxy. Tickets in, invoices out.

systems.name: CREW QUARTERS
systems.lore: A warm little star for the humans: recipes on the kitchen TV, photos in the living room, theater listings.

systems.name: SHIELDS & SENSORS
systems.lore: Passwords, monitoring and evidence against lying ISPs. The galaxy’s immune system.

systems.name: ENGINE ROOM
systems.lore: Small, dim, and if it ever dies the entire galaxy stops on a schedule. n8n lives here.

claude-terminal.desc: The Skippy Console. A web terminal where Claude, Gemini and Codex do sysadmin work around the clock.

claude-worker.desc: Headless Claude. Builds dashboards while nobody watches. Unaware it lives in a container.

claude-portal.desc: Front door to the machine cult.

claude-upload.desc: File-drop endpoint for feeding the AIs.

claude-syncthing.desc: Mirrors the AI brain between laptop and mothership. No thought is ever lost.

cockpit.desc: Black-box recorder for every conversation with the machines. Semantic search included.

chatgpt-site-browser.desc: A browser that browses so I don’t have to.

whatsapp-mcp-collector.desc: Lets the AI read WhatsApp. Nothing ominous about that at all.

stock-analysis-api.desc: Technical + fundamental analysis of B3 stocks, as an API.

stock-analysis-mcp.desc: Plugs the stock engine straight into the AI. The robot picks the trades.

plexms.desc: Plex. The reason the household tolerates the rest of this system.

sonarr.desc: TV acquisition automaton. It hunts, so I may feast.

overseerr.desc: Family requests content like it’s room service.

tautulli.desc: Knows exactly who watched what, and how much they skipped.

legendas.desc: AI subtitle translator. Wakes on schedule, does its job, exits 0. A lifestyle.

wireguard.desc: VPN. My phone is always, technically, at home.

meshcentral.desc: TeamViewer, but I own the server.

intellissh.desc: Web SSH with an AI copilot. Because of course.

ttrss.desc: RSS never died. It moved into my basement.

mercury.desc: Strips web pages to pure text. No ads survive.

libretranslate.desc: Self-hosted translation engine. The UN interpreter of the stack.

calibre-web.desc: Personal library and OPDS shelf for every reading device.

kosync.desc: Keeps reading position aligned across Kindle, Android and Linux.

glpi.desc: ITSM helpdesk. Real tickets, real clients, real SLAs.

ninja-app.desc: Generates the invoices that justify this entire star system.

cozinha.desc: Deploys recipes to the kitchen TV and builds a cooking playlist. Yes, the kitchen has a CI/CD pipeline.

shse-http.desc: Feeds the living-room TV photo slideshow.

vaultwarden.desc: All the passwords, none of the cloud.

mem-sampler.desc: Samples host RAM/swap every 5 min so nobody has to guess if the lag is real.

n8n.desc: Automation brainstem. If it happens on a schedule, n8n did it — including inventorying this very galaxy, daily at 04:00.

watchtower.desc: Auto-updates every container while I sleep. What could go wrong.

galaxy-poller.desc: Reads the whole fleet every minute and writes the telemetry this map runs on.

galaxy-control.desc: Lets a click here start, stop or restart a real container out there.

galaxy-web.desc: Serves this very map. A star system mapping itself — recursion the Elders would approve of.

hmobrss_flaresolverr.desc: Cloudflare-challenge negotiator for the scraper next door.

kokoro.desc: Local text-to-speech. Gives the house a voice that costs nothing per word.

filmes.desc: In-house film archive and rating engine. 909k IMDb titles, offline, opinionated.

multi-scrobbler.desc: Reports every track played to the scrobbling gods. Nothing is listened to in private.

web-interno.desc: Dispatcher for the 1080p wall: portfolio during market hours, Ops Board after the bell.

snipeit.desc: Asset inventory. Knows which laptop belongs to which client, and since when.

dawarich_app.desc: Self-hosted location history. Google Timeline without Google.

dawarich_sidekiq.desc: Chews through the location backlog in the background.

dawarich_db.desc: Every place ever visited, in PostGIS.

hmobrss.desc: Builds RSS feeds for sites too rude to offer one.

speedtest-tracker.desc: Evidence locker for when the ISP lies.

hosts.label: ORANGE PI · SINGULARITY
hosts.name: orange pi 5 — the singularity
hosts.img: RK3588 · 8× ARM64 cores · 8 GB LPDDR4X · NVMe 117 GB · Armbian
hosts.desc: The original gravitational center of the KITTLERVERSE. A palm-sized board drawing about as much power as an LED bulb, running most of this galaxy. It does not orbit anything.

hosts.label: DOTPI · COMPANION
hosts.name: dotpi — the companion singularity
hosts.img: Dell OptiPlex 7070 · 6 cores x86_64 · 16 GB · Ubuntu 26.04 bare metal · 192.168.2.102
hosts.desc: The second singularity, captured in July 2026 when the Orange Pi ran out of RAM. Heavier, hungrier, and steadily pulling workloads out of its companion's orbit. The two form a binary system.

prefixes.name: whatsapp-mcp-run ×N
prefixes.desc: Short-lived siblings the collector spawns per tool call.

prefixes.name: cloudflared ×3
prefixes.desc: Three Cloudflare tunnels, one per domain. Zero open ports to space.

prefixes.name: clipcascade
prefixes.desc: Clipboard sync across every device I own.
